# yabbistir extensions

> Extensions for yabbistir, a clipboard history app for macOS. An extension is TypeScript bundled into one JavaScript file that runs in JavaScriptCore, not Node, inside yabbistir's helper process. It only computes; the app draws every piece of UI.

Commands run from the repository's root: `npm run new -- <id> --template <action|detector|capture-rule|job>` creates an extension in `extensions/<id>/`, then `npm test -- <id>`, `npm run validate -- <id>` and `npm run build -- <id>` check it. Coding agents start with AGENTS.md. llms-full.txt holds every document below in one file.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the working guide: repository map, commands, rules, the definition of done, common mistakes
- [README.md](README.md): what this repository is, installing extensions, five steps to your first one
- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md): a first action from scratch, with its test, built and linked into the app
- [Concepts](docs/concepts.md): item, context, action, detector, capture rule, job, result, and which contribution point fits an idea

- [Manifest](docs/manifest.md): every manifest.json field (generated from the schema)
- [API](docs/api.md): every type and every `yab` function (generated from the TSDoc)
- [Permissions](docs/permissions.md): network, exec, capture and history: when each is needed and what the person sees
- [Errors](docs/errors.md): every validator message, build error and runtime error code, with its cause and fix

## Guides

- [Jobs](docs/jobs.md): long-running actions with progress and cancel

- [Detectors and previews](docs/detectors-and-previews.md): tagging copied items and adding preview sections
- [Capture rules](docs/capture-rules.md): changing or dropping a copy before it is stored
- [Localization](docs/localization.md): locale files, keys, `yab.t`, keywords
- [Testing](docs/testing.md): the fake host and what it checks
- [Design guidelines](docs/design-guidelines.md): naming, icons, short text, the app's calm grey look
